title: Kirby Problem 1.38
exact_target: Study the smooth concordance group and its topologically slice subgroup, asking about higher torsion, representatives of order-two classes and the stated infinitely-many-integers divisibility condition.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2697 (KP-1.38). CC BY 4.0.
R. \.{I}nan\c{c} Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman, K3 -- A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology, author preliminary edition (2026), Problem 1.38 and its remarks.
